g.text: Validation and test each contain 127 held-out targets; lower MSE is better.
Zero strength was selected on validation: C3 predictions equal the no-effect controls.
RNA-only, one seed; the gene axis is a post-hoc cross-study intersection.
Genes are normalized before excluding the perturbed gene from each target's MSE.
Input and reference controls are approximately batch matched and can be reused.
Count-like source X is not proven raw; not an external blind test or official score.
